Hi Jordan,

I missed you for our 9:00 AM ET discovery earlier — totally fine, hope everything's okay on your end.

I'm eager to get a quick follow-up on timeline and technical owners so we can scope a short demo/technical deep dive. A few options that work on my side next week:

- Tue 10/6 10:00–10:30 PT / 1:00–1:30 ET
- Wed 10/7 11:00–11:30 PT / 2:00–2:30 ET
- Thu 10/8 14:00–14:30 PT / 17:00–17:30 ET

If none of these work, send two windows that do and I'll lock one in. To make sure we don't miss each other again, can you either: 1) reply with the exact slot you want (and write "CONFIRMED" in the reply), or 2) accept the calendar invite once I send it? I'll include the technical contact (if you want them on the call) and a short agenda:

Proposed 30-min agenda:
- 5 min intros + context
- 10 min discovery (current infra & eval criteria)
- 10 min how Redwood handles inference: routing, cost controls, and private options
- 5 min next steps / mutual action plan

I've attached a short mutual action plan and one-pager to give context. Also please confirm the best phone number for an audible on the day in case of conflicts.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
